scenes.text: A whole is divided into 2 equal halves. We already have 1 of the parts. How many more equal parts make one whole? (Puzzle 1) Let us think carefully. A whole has 2 equal pieces. We have 1, so we need 2 minus 1 equals 1 more. The answer is 1. Great work!

A whole is divided into 4 equal quarters. We already have 1 of the parts. How many more equal parts make one whole? (Puzzle 2) Let us think carefully. A whole has 4 equal pieces. We have 1, so we need 4 minus 1 equals 3 more. The answer is 3. Great work!

A whole is divided into 4 equal quarters. We already have 2 of the parts. How many more equal parts make one whole? (Puzzle 3) Let us think carefully. A whole has 4 equal pieces. We have 2, so we need 4 minus 2 equals 2 more. The answer is 2. Great work!
